mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in corporate demand (GDPC1) signals stronger economic activity, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of rising GDPC1.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates monetary easing, lowering discount rates and increasing present value of future cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline during easing periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.8% triggers concerns about labor market tightness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 4.8%.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 244.5 signals inflationary pressures, prompting market anticipation of rate hikes and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during inflationary periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in corporate demand (GDPC1) create a synergistic easing environment, amplifying positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly higher than baseline when proxies move in opposite directions.

mechanism_narrative: Strong supply growth (INDPRO) coupled with low unemployment (UNRATE) signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive when proxies move in opposite directions.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (INDPRO > 105 and UNRATE < 4.5%), strong supply growth and low unemployment drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive during late-cycle expansion periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production demand (HOUST) reflects growing economic activity, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising HOUST.
